t: This is Lisson Gallery, one of the longest-running international contemporary art galleries in the world, with other spaces in New York, Los Angeles and Shanghai. It began in 1967, when Nicholas Logsdail founded it on Bell Street in Lisson Grove. He is still its co-owner, and he has been awarded an OBE. So the gallery you're visiting has stayed tied to the person who started it for well over half a century.
